summary: Iteration 15 · Sync multi-device (heartbeat/push/pull), server-side PDF /api/pdf/render, client-side html2pdf download, STD-vs-PREMIUM plan gating (Utilidades menu with badge/lock), Trial 60 days, landing page copy, sumBox 'Saldo anterior caja' fix. All 7 backend pytest PASS. All 15+ frontend checks PASS. Real PDF download confirmed (307,639 B, magic %PDF).
action_items: None blocking. The Sync indicator shows 'hb HTTP 404' when a MASTER offline key is active — this is EXPECTED (offline-signed key is not in Mongo licenses collection). If desired, front-end could suppress heartbeat calls when license.type==='MASTER' or when key doesn't look like a JWT (starts with 'ey'), to avoid the noisy 404 badge for owner-mode. Non-blocking cosmetic.
critical_code_review_comments: SYNC (/api/sync/*) — VERIFIED end-to-end: heartbeat correctly returns 404 for unknown license, 200 with authorized/is_premium/plan/max_devices for real DB license, and device_limit_reached=true on the 3rd unique install_id (per PREMIUM_PLANS set {PRM,PREMIUM,TRIAL,MASTER} and MAX_DEVICES_PREMIUM=2). push returns 403 sync_requires_premium for STD plan and writes entries with LWW timestamps for PRM. pull returns pushed entries with cloud_updated_at. Key hashing (sha256) used as _id — good pattern.
PDF /api/pdf/render — VERIFIED: 200 with content-type application/pdf, %PDF magic bytes, content-disposition attachment. Playwright-based server render works.
html2pdf.js@0.10.1 client-side PDF — VERIFIED: downloaded a real 307,639-byte PDF from #btnPrint. The window.print() → html2pdf swap is fully functional in v2.html. jsDelivr CDN loads cleanly.

PLAN GATING — VERIFIED: refreshUtilitiesPremiumUI() correctly flips document.body.data-not-premium between '0' (MASTER/PRM/TRIAL) and '1' (STD). #utilPremiumBadge shows '⭐ 🚀' when premium, hidden when STD. Clicking any Utilidades item (btnSms, btnCalendar, btnAI, btnAudit) as STD opens the premium-upgrade-modal with all data-testids present (premium-modal-close, premium-see-plans, premium-later, premium-upgrade-modal).
TRIAL 60 dies — VERIFIED in /app/frontend/src/components/admin/AdminDashboard.jsx line 588: `if (plan === 'TRIAL') { defaultDays = '60'; planLabel = 'TRIAL 60 dies (accés complet Premium)'; }`.
LANDING PAGE — VERIFIED at /downloads/landing-medicarplus.html: contains '60 días' (not '30 días'), 'UTILIDADES DESBLOQUEADAS', '2 ordenadores sincronizados', prices '29,90' + '39,90'.

SUMBOX 'Saldo anterior' — VERIFIED: sumBox innerHTML (v2.html line 2072) only contains the 'Saldo anterior caja' row. The bare 'Saldo anterior' string that remained is in the top-header pill #saldoAnt (line 208) and in the i18n dictionary (line 404) — NOT inside .sumBox. Regex /Saldo anterior(?! caja)/ on runtime sumBox.innerHTML returned false. Fix confirmed.
AUDITORÍA TOOLTIP — VERIFIED at runtime: #btnAudit has ? immediately after 'Auditoría' label. All 3 required phrases present ('errores más rápidamente', 'duplicad', 'cuota/0€').

SYNC INDICATOR — VERIFIED: #syncIndicator element created dynamically, has data-testid='sync-indicator', position:fixed with bottom offset (visible bottom-right of page). Text starts populating as soon as heartbeat runs.

MINOR (cosmetic): #utilPremiumBadge computed display is 'block' rather than the spec's 'inline-block' — the review request said `display=='inline-block'`. It DOES render correctly on screen. If exact CSS value matters, tweak the inline style; otherwise behaviourally equivalent.

MINOR (cosmetic): with MASTER offline key active, syncIndicator shows '☁️ ⚠️ hb HTTP 404' because MASTER isn't a DB license. This is expected per the agent-to-agent note but is user-visible noise on preview. Consider skipping heartbeat when license.source==='offline' or license.key doesn't start with 'ey'.

CODE QUALITY (sync.py): clean, well-documented, uses proper async/await, sha256 hashing, Pydantic models with min/max lengths, ISO timestamps with tz, LWW conflict resolution. No _id leakage (uses hash as _id but never returns it to client). ≈207 lines — well within budget.

success_rate.backend: 100% (7/7 tests passed — heartbeat 404, heartbeat premium authorized+is_premium+max_devices=2, device limit reached on 3rd install_id, push 403 for STD, push writes 2 entries for PRM, pull returns pushed entries, pdf/render returns %PDF)
success_rate.frontend: 100% (btnPrint text='📥 Descargar PDF', client-side html2pdf downloaded 307,639 B real PDF with %PDF magic, #utilPremiumBadge visible with '⭐ 🚀' for MASTER, body.data-not-premium='0' MASTER / '1' STD, downgrade flips badge to hidden, clicking #btnSms as STD opens premium-upgrade-modal with all data-testids, Auditoría tooltip present with correct copy, syncIndicator visible bottom-right, sumBox has no bare 'Saldo anterior' row, landing page copy correct, AdminDashboard TRIAL defaultDays=60)

context_for_next_testing_agent: IMPORTANT: /api/licenses/generate enforces install_id regex CD-XXXX-XXXX-XXXX-XXXX with UPPERCASE hex only (see licenses.py validator). Any test that mints a license via admin endpoint must generate an install_id matching this pattern. MASTER offline key CANNOT be used against /api/sync/* — it will return 404 because it's not persisted in Mongo. Always mint a real PRM/STD license via /api/licenses/generate first. For sync heartbeat device-limit test, use 3 DIFFERENT install_ids against the same license_key: 1st + 2nd accepted, 3rd returns device_limit_reached=true. Sync push requires 'entries' as dict {key: {value:.., updated_at:ISO}}. Client-side PDF download in v2.html uses html2pdf.js@0.10.1 from jsDelivr — verified with page.expect_download() (returns 307 KB pdf).
rca of the issue: N/A — verification pass.
